llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed wrapper around a third-party image-generation CLI, with expected network upload and API-key handling for that purpose.

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses sending prompts, parameters, and user-supplied local media paths/files to dLazy API and storage endpoints, which is proportionate for cloud image generation.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses a pinned npm package, @dlazy/cli@1.2.3, with an npx alternative; this is disclosed and conventional, but it relies on a third-party package.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger phrases include broad image-generation terms, so users should expect ordinary image requests may route through this provider when the skill is installed; this is broad but not hidden or unrelated.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The CLI may persist an API key in ~/.dlazy/config.json and a global binary may be installed; both are disclosed, and no background service, privilege escalation, tool hijacking, or destructive persistence appears in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Nano Banana 2.0 image generation/editing through dLazy, and the documented commands, API endpoints, prompt handling, and optional local image inputs all align with that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable using dLazy as the image provider. Prompts and any local images you pass can be uploaded to dLazy services, and authentication may store an API key locally in the dLazy CLI config.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The English file links to the Chinese localization, and both referenced files were available and inspected; this does not support an evasion concern.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger terms are related to image generation/editing and the provider behavior is disclosed, though users should be aware this may activate the dLazy CLI for generic image requests.
[P9] expected: Manual review found the reported long spaces in markdown table formatting near error examples, with no hidden instructions or concealed content.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese wording appears in the Chinese localization and mirrors the English file's error-handling guidance; it does not create hidden behavior beyond localized user guidance.
